name: RonanRx Inc.
long_description:
RonanRX helps you personalize GLP-1s like Ozempic, peptides, and other treatments using your labs, wearables, medical history, treatment response, and the latest medical research. Instead of treating the average patient, we continuously personalize your treatment as your body changes.

We've built the complete feedback loop for personalized medicine: your health data automatically syncs into one place, AI helps personalize treatment, licensed doctors make prescribing decisions, medications are delivered to your door, and every outcome continuously improves your protocol.

Connect your health data once. RonanRX automatically syncs your labs, wearables, and medical records into a single AI-powered health profile that helps personalize GLP-1s like Ozempic, peptides, supplements, and other treatments around your biology. If prescribed, your medication is delivered to your door.

Our founders have built and exited multiple companies, raised over $100M, and previously built a $50M U.S. medical manufacturing business.

Start with a text at RonanRX.com and become the maximum version of yourself,
one_liner: We use AI to personalize peptides to your biology
